The participation value flow (TRUST → UTILITY → ECONOMIC ACTIVITY → QPF PARTICIPATION) is stated as PROPOSED design posture, explicitly distinguished from TRUST → PAYWALL → REVENUE, and bound to the existing VERIFY ≠ AUTHORIZE ≠ EXECUTE ≠ SETTLE invariant.
Protocol neutrality and the plug-in posture (verify anything, not own everything) are restatements of the provider-independence property P-IND, with any third-party reliance claim labeled UNVERIFIED.

The public falsifiability doctrine is grounded in the existing attack-kit surface (deploy/attack-kit.html, docs/outreach/EXT-001/README.md) and external verification suite, classifying breaks as evidence without modifying any deploy artifact.

The OINIO identity layer and agent-as-economic-actor positioning cite 12-identity-artifact.md scope limits (knowledge_body; not a legal person) and do not create, activate, or authorize any economic capability.
Existing canonical documents are not contradicted; frozen epistemic enums and capability classifications are preserved.
No live economic or privileged execution capability is enabled.
